nfcorpus.purpose: nutritional/health information retrieval benchmark judged by upstream authors

evaluation: BEIR test split only, no training. Original per-query judgments defined by original benchmark authors, not generated from our BM25 runs.
explicit_no_claims: not four-source breast-cancer relevance ground truth
not matched BCKB role-query external replication
not statistically independent query sampling by default

four_conditions.G00: R0 original title+text concatenated, Q0 first 48 distinct tokenized query content tokens
four_conditions.G01: R0, Q1 same tokens plus literal title and abstract marker tokens; all fixed
four_conditions.G10: R1 adds fixed literal title and abstract strings to title+text fields, Q0

independence: Original qrel authorship independent of our study-created Formal40 silver labels, but benchmark queries/document positives may overlap and are not four-source breast-cancer clinical gold.

metrics.primary: mean per-query binary or graded linear nDCG@10 as declared in each benchmark qrels
metrics.report_criteria: all results including null or negative effects; no mandatory positive sign
metrics.statistical_inference: Descriptive per-query only; no p-values until query/label overlap dependencies are checked

name: CMPB cross-benchmark independent-source relevance contrast, zero-trained lexical system
no_tuning_policy: Do not change representation, query, tokenizer, BM25 weights, or inclusion after any qrel/test evaluation. If exception needed freeze NEW post-hoc label, do not quietly replace preregistered.
publication_boundary: Keep BEIR-derived corpus text, queries and official qrels local; public source code, source URLs/hashes, numeric derived aggregate and synthetic tests only; original license info links and any noncommercial restrictions respected.
publication_target: Non-default branch of existing wsjforgit/ipm-v35-reproducibility only after freeze/QA; no forced push, never main.

retrieval.system: SQLite FTS5 porter unicode61 BM25 defaults
